clue.text: Opening stairs for approach to higher regions?

parts.note: a space is an opening or gap
a flight is a run of stairs

explanation.surface: Someone climbs a stairway that opens onto the upper floors of a building.
explanation.walkthrough: The stairs seem to lead to an attic, but the higher regions are outer space.
explanation.definitionFit: Travel by rocket is how humans reach the upper atmosphere and beyond, hence the playful question mark.

clue.text: Ends in the Government blocking law award?

indicators.note: to block something is to sit in its way, so these letters are lodged inside another word

parts.note: a statute is a written law

indicators.note: the ends of words are their final letters, so only the closing letter of each following word is kept

parts.note: the final letters of the two words

explanation.walkthrough: The pair of end letters goes into STATUTE after its fifth letter, making STATUETTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small figurine such as the Oscar is handed out as a prize, so the trophy is an example of an award.

clue.text: Indication we'll have to act when boarding coach after everyone

indicators.note: the following pieces come behind the first one in reading order
a passenger boarding a vehicle gets inside it, so one word goes within another

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A sign that passengers climbing onto a bus behind the whole crowd will need to move.
explanation.walkthrough: A stage is short for stagecoach. The phrase opens Jaques's famous speech in Shakespeare's As You Like It.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's line says every person is a player, so it implies all of us must perform roles.

clue.text: Penetrate the heart of America, not the top

indicators.note: in a down entry the top is the first letter, and 'not' tells us to drop it

explanation.walkthrough: 'Heart of America' suggests picking out middle letters, but it means the American spelling of centre.

clue.text: Irish figures reel as punch is thrown

indicators.note: something thrown is scattered and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Irish characters stagger when a blow is landed in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: A reel is also an Irish dance, which helps the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: These mischievous little men of folklore are creatures from Irish legend.

clue.text: Old King freely exhibiting unctuousness?

parts.note: GR is Georgius Rex, King George

explanation.surface: A former monarch openly shows his oily, ingratiating manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Unctuousness is oiliness, literal or of manner, so acting in a fatty, slick way fits the adverb.

clue.text: Author remains confused, having missed a statement from Pope

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up and need sorting into a new order
missing something means leaving it out, so one letter of that kind drops from the fodder

explanation.surface: A bewildered writer lost something and now hears a pronouncement from the Vatican.
explanation.walkthrough: Pope is Alexander Pope, the poet, not the head of the Catholic Church.

clue.text: Proof bar has brought in learner, one that's overworked

clue.text: Guzzler decided to avoid opening variable bottle

indicators.note: avoiding the opening means skipping the first letter

clue.text: Permission to take off

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to depart or go away

clue.text: Nasty beard smears will make you self-conscious

indicators.note: something nasty is messy, hinting the letters are made into a mess

clue.text: African ecosystem re-created as green site

indicators.note: something re-created is made over again, so the letters are rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A wildlife habitat in Africa is rebuilt on a patch of grassland.

clue.text: Enjoying the atmosphere? That's risky in part of London

clue.text: What makes bone bony? Simple

clue.text: Distribute vote to oust leader

clue.text: Appear in front and pressure soldiers to surrender

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure
to cede is to give up

clue.text: Scented substance good in Morning Fruit (not ultimate in perfume)

not tells us that the selected letter is taken away
the ultimate letter is the very last one of the next word

clue.text: Knight, beset by flies in sun resolved to take armour off

N is knight in chess notation

clue.text: Radical not right about husband? It's misleading information

clue.text: Choose not to stop dance held by the wealthy below tower

clue.text: European journalists tucking into very good coffee

parts.note: so as in so good, the intensifier

clue.text: Fibres a touch hard in place for horses

H for hard, as on pencils

clue.text: Acclaim of the French: a record by old man climbing

clue.text: Pasta dish, note, involved in US city story

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sporting' looks like a verb for wearing the hat; it is the adjective meaning fit and fond of sport.

clue.text: Beer conceals when one's missing exams

clue.text: Regret backing drug element

clue.text: Watch, taking in the fielder beginning to play game
